body: Any info if this will be resolved in some minor version or in v12?
@belchevgb , I will check this one, thanks!

The problem is that when you call setTimeout in afterViewInit this async task gets scheduled and the task is stored in tasksByHandleId. When we call ngOnDestroy and clearSetTimeout, this tries to remove the given task from tasksByHandleId cache, but it is with status "not scheduled", so this task never gets removed.
@belchevgb , I can reproduce now, thanks for reporting this issue, I will create a PR to fix it asap.
